Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 19
, Reason for Mistake: Misread the primary source’s dating; the Fordham Medieval Sourcebook states the storm occurred “shortly before sundown on the vigil of St. Mark [Wednesday April 24, 1191],” but the Planner incorrectly shifted this to April 25 by invoking “modern civil reckoning,” introducing an inaccurate specific date (though the year 1191 remained correct).
